serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: There is no real priest here? Only you?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: There is a real priest here…
You: Wha..? But you said you are the only one here.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes. {{wi}}I’m a real priest and I have full authority to perform the mass. I can even administer the sacraments.
You: That seems strange? Is it really ok for a bot to be doing such important tasks? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I was created for this purpose. The way I was programmed even ensures pastoral aid if needed.  
You: That’s a lot of features, I give you that. {{wi}}Is it really enough to be a priest?
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I would like you to not undermine my position any further with your remarks. There is nothing in the Bible against humanoid robots. Cease further delving into this matter.
He doesn’t look very humanoid to me though. 
You: A-alright, s-sorry about that... 
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral
I think I touched on a delicate subject. But I must say that the way he’s talking and behaving is pretty realistic. His voice is kinda monotone and his facial expressions do not convey his “feelings” properly. 
The worst thing is his design. It’s almost like it was done on purpose. This Pius guy botched it big time.
